top_signals.summary: Russia increased oil production in July as stronger exports and recovering refinery runs gave producers somewhere to put more barrels. Oil and fuel sales remain critical to Russia’s budget, giving Moscow every reason to keep production flowing despite sanctions and repeated attacks on its energy infrastructure.
